build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: All hosts use __now(). Native before/after rebuilt with identical console-only steady_clock patch. Sub-millisecond monotonic clock checks pass. Historical native timings used Date.now fallback; low-percent differences should be assessed within this paired run.
benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
  case "$1" in
    before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-borrowed-number-hires "$2" ;;
    after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-rtf-direct-number-hires "$2" ;;
    magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
  esac
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
  if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-final-number-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-final-number-tag-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-final-number-size-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-final-number-locale-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
done

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
  case "$1" in

    after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-rtf-direct-number-hires "$2" ;;
    magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
  esac
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
  if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-final-number-constructor-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-rtf-final-number-relative-$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
done
order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations plus canonical and isolated Locale controls per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings. Constructor and relative-time controls run separately afterward in the same alternating host order.
outputChecks: 459 values checked (297 overlap, 27 canonical tag controls, 18 isolated Locale controls, 45 list-size controls, 36 constructor controls, 36 relative controls). All FormatJS before/after values match. Only comparator differences, in overlap and constructor controls: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Pass pre-coerced JS numbers directly through JSI/C ABI to a numeric Rust core. Preserve original f64 through validation, named-form lookup and direction. Convert the positive magnitude with a stack ryu buffer only if a numeric pattern is needed; remove redundant integral .0 before common decimal formatting. Old string APIs and ABI remain; shared validation/UTF16 unit handling/output ownership remain.

unitCodeExperiment.change: Pass original coerced f64 and normalized unit code through JSI. JS still performs ToNumber then ToString on unit; private null-prototype map preserves valid singular/plural units and rejects unknowns. Numeric core retains f64 through finite/direction/named-form selection; stack ryu conversion of magnitude occurs only for numeric patterns. Legacy string/UTF16 ABI remains. Shared guarded handle/output ownership supports both paths.

bridgeTrialMeaning: before is direct-number UTF16 unit transport; after is rejected JS unit-code lookup; comparator unchanged. Four isolated cases, alternating three-round CPU0 order. Both product snapshots retained in earlier experiment data.
